beforeImage.name: Excelsior U.S. Solar & Storage Portfolio
beforeImage.description: This portfolio comprises operating US solar and solar-plus-storage assets acquired from Excelsior Energy Capital. The assets sell power under contracted structures and therefore have an operating model tied to long-lived renewable generation infrastructure rather than a development-only pipeline. Its revenue profile is asset-heavy and contracted because cash flows depend on the operating performance of the underlying projects and customer agreements. Public transaction materials described a 38-project portfolio totaling 89 MW across multiple US states. The assets form part of BlackRock's Evergreen Infrastructure strategy focused on energy transition and energy security investments. BlackRock's Evergreen Infrastructure fund acquired the portfolio in March 2024, and Excelsior announced that it had sold the sub-portfolio to BlackRock.

afterImage.name: Lighthouse
afterImage.subsector: Commercial and industrial distributed solar and solar-plus-storage
afterImage.description: Lighthouse is a portfolio of 38 operating commercial-and-industrial distributed solar and solar-plus-storage projects totaling 89 MWDC across California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont and Washington. The portfolio is asset-heavy and contracted, with operating renewable-generation and storage assets serving long-term commercial and industrial offtakers. BlackRock's Evergreen infrastructure strategy signed to acquire Lighthouse in November 2023 and the sale closed in December 2023. Excelsior Energy Capital sold 100% of its membership interests in the portfolio through Excelsior Renewable Energy Investment Fund I LP and disclosed the completed exit in March 2024. The transaction disclosure does not establish that BlackRock owns 100% of every project's total economic interests, so the current platform-level percentage is not inferred. Lighthouse is counted once as the manager-level portfolio; its 38 underlying project and SPV assets are not separate PortCos. No later portfolio sale, transfer or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through August 23, 2026.
